texts.ABILITY_SHIELD: When combat begins, the holder and allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW receive 20% of their max HP as SHIELD and SAFEGUARD for 5 seconds
texts.ABSORB_BULB: All the damage reduction is absorbed by the bulb. Once under 50% HP, bulb explodes, dealing all damage absorbed to ADJACENT enemy units as SPECIAL.
texts.AGUAV_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, restore 50% HP and get CONFUSION for 3 seconds
texts.AIR_BALLOON: Gives FLYING synergy. Gain 10% chance to dodge attacks and immunity to any BOARD_EFFECT.
texts.AMULET_COIN:
+1 GOLD each time the holder knocks out an opponent.
Reduce max interest cap by 10 GOLD.
texts.AQUA_EGG: The holder regains 20% of its max PP after casting its ability, + 2 PP for each cast done in the fight
texts.ASSAULT_VEST: +40 SPE_DEF. Reduce BURN and POISONNED damage by 50%
texts.BALL: A ball made of a large hard berry. When casting ability, throws the ball to the furthest FIELD ally to pass them the BALL and 50 SHIELD. If no FIELD ally with a free item slot at sight, throws the ball to the furthest enemy instead, dealing [30,SP]% of user's SPEED as PHYSICAL
texts.BERSERK_GENE: Gives MONSTER synergy. The holder gets CONFUSION for 1 second if gaining MONSTER stacks.
texts.BIG_EATER_BELT: Increase all stat buffs received by 25% (rounded down, not affecting PP). Allows the wearer to eat 2 different dishes per round.
texts.BLACK_BELT: Critical attacks provide 33% of the damage dealt as SHIELD.
texts.BLUE_ORB: Every 3 attacks, unleashes a chain lightning that bounces to the 2 closest enemies, dealing 10 SPECIAL and burning 15 PP
texts.BUG_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get BUG type.
texts.CHEF_HAT: The holder will cook their Signature Dish between rounds.
texts.CHESTO_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being SLEEP, heal 50 HP and give +50 AP and immunity to SLEEP for the rest of the fight
texts.COOKING_POT: Gives GOURMET synergy. When BURN, the COOKING_POT is heated little by little which gives 10 SPEED per second.
texts.COVER_BAND: If an ADJACENT ally is about to get KO with some incoming damage, the wearer takes the damage instead.
texts.DARK_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get DARK type.
texts.DAWN_STONE: The holder gains the PSYCHIC type
texts.DEEP_SEA_TOOTH: Holder restore 5 additional PP ON_ATTACK. If the attack knocks out the target, restore 15 additional PP.
texts.DRAGON_SCALE: Gives DRAGON synergy as first synergy.
texts.DUSK_STONE: The holder gains the DARK type
texts.DYNAMAX_BAND: At the start of the fight, raise max HP by 200%.
texts.EFFICIENT_BANDANNA: The holder and allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW have their max PP reduced by 15%.
texts.ELECTIRIZER: Gives ELECTRIC synergy. Every third attack inflicts PARALYSIS for 2 seconds ON_HIT.
texts.ELECTRIC_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get ELECTRIC type.
texts.EVIOLITE: Holder gets a bunch of stats, but can no longer evolve. Can only be given to non-fully evolved Pokémon.
texts.EXPLORER_KIT: Gives GROUND synergy. Increase the [LK] chance to find gold buried in the ground.
texts.EXPLOSIVE_BAND: The first time user shield is depleted, this item explodes, dealing 50% of all SHIELD gained so far as SPECIAL to ADJACENT enemies.
texts.EXP_SHARE: Get the best ATK, AP, DEF and SPE_DEF values of allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW.
texts.FAIRY_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get FAIRY type.
texts.FIGHTING_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get FIGHTING type.
texts.FIRE_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get FIRE type.
texts.FIRE_STONE: The holder gains the FIRE type
texts.FLAME_ORB: Holder increases its base ATK by 100% and is immune to FREEZE, but suffers from BURN during the entire fight.
texts.FOSSIL_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get FOSSIL type.
texts.FOSSIL_STONE: A fossil of a Pokémon that lived in prehistoric times
texts.FRIEND_BOW: The holder gains the NORMAL type.
texts.GANLON_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 20 DEF
texts.GHOST_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get GHOST type.
texts.GOLDEN_NANAB_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50% of max HP and player gains 5 GOLD.
texts.GOLDEN_PINAP_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50% of max HP and player gains 3 random SWEETS.
texts.GOLDEN_RAZZ_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50% of max HP and player gains 6 free shop rerolls.
texts.GOLD_BOTTLE_CAP: +1% CRIT_POWER per GOLD you have. Gain 1 GOLD per KO. If eliminating the last enemy, get a Jackpot that doubles the amount gained during the round.
texts.GOLD_BOW: The holder does not count for team size limit.
texts.GOLD_MASK: At the start of the fight, spawn 3 Pokémon that share a type with the holder. Rarity and tier scale with stage level.
texts.GOURMET_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get GOURMET type.
texts.GRACIDEA_FLOWER: When combat begins, the holder and allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW gain +20 SPEED
texts.GREEN_ORB: Holder and ADJACENT allies regain 5% of their max HP every 2 seconds. 30% of overheal is converted to PP.
texts.HEAVY_DUTY_BOOTS: Holder is immune to any BOARD_EFFECT, forced displacement and LOCKED
texts.ICE_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get ICE type.
texts.ICE_STONE: The holder gains the ICE type
texts.INCENSE: Gives FLORA synergy. Each Pokémon in shop has an additional 5% chance to share a common synergy with the holder.
texts.JABOCA_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and cast Spiky Shield for 10 seconds
texts.KINGS_ROCK: +100 HP. 20% of max HP are gained as SHIELD when combat begins.
texts.LANSAT_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 50% CRIT_CHANCE
texts.LEAF_STONE: The holder gains the GRASS type
texts.LIECHI_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 15 ATK
texts.LOADED_DICE: Attacks have [50,LK]% chance to also hit the lowest health enemy ADJACENT to target for 75% of the damage, which also trigger ON_HIT effects.
texts.LUCKY_RIBBON: Holder gets 20 LUCK and has [15,LK]% chance to dodge attacks.
texts.LUM_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP, clear negative status and get SAFEGUARD for 5 seconds
texts.MAGMARIZER: Gives FIRE synergy. The holder doesn't take BURN damage. Instead, it gains 30 SPEED when burning.
texts.MAX_ELIXIR: Restores 100% of max PP 1 second after the first ability cast.
texts.MAX_REVIVE: Give RESURRECTION, preventing the holder first KO and restoring to max HP
texts.METRONOME: Gives SOUND synergy. Every second, the holder gains 5 PP.
texts.MOON_STONE: The holder gains the FAIRY type
texts.MUSCLE_BAND: When the holder takes damage, gain 1 stack. Every 2 stacks, the holder gains +2 DEF, +1 ATK and +5 SPEED (max 20 stacks)
texts.NULLIFY_BANDANNA: Holder can no longer cast its ability. AP is converted to ATK (5:1), and PP are converted to bonus SPECIAL on next attack.
texts.OLD_AMBER: The holder gains the FOSSIL type
texts.PERSIM_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP or after being CONFUSION, heal 50 HP and give 10 SPE_DEF and immunity to CONFUSION for the rest of the fight
texts.PETAYA_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 80 AP
texts.POISON_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get POISON type.
texts.POKEMONOMICON: When the holder deals SPECIAL, they BURN the target for 3 seconds and reduce its SPE_DEF by 1.
texts.POKERUS_VIAL: Gives POISON synergy. Infects the holder with POKERUS, gaining 1 ATK and 10 AP every 3 seconds and transmitting to ADJACENT allies.
texts.POKE_DOLL: Reduce all incoming PHYSICAL and SPECIAL by 30%. Makes the holder more likely to be targeted.
texts.POWER_LENS: The amount of SPECIAL blocked by SPE_DEF is inflicted back to the attacker
texts.PROTECTIVE_PADS: Holder deals double damage against units with  SHIELD, and is protected from recoil damage and retaliation effects.
texts.PSYCHIC_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get PSYCHIC type.
texts.PUNCHING_GLOVE: Attacks deal 8 % of target max HP as additional PHYSICAL ON_HIT
texts.RARE_CANDY: Immediately make a Pokémon evolve. Can only be given to Pokémon that can evolve, and reduce its sell price to its previous tier.
texts.RAZOR_FANG: Attacks apply ARMOR_BREAK for 2 seconds ON_HIT.
texts.REAPER_CLOTH: The holder's ability can now critically strike based on CRIT_CHANCE. If the ability can already critically strike by default, increase CRIT_POWER by 50% instead.
texts.RED_ORB: 25% of attack damage is dealt as TRUE
texts.REPEAT_BALL: Each time you spend gold on a reroll, gain 1 free reroll. For every 2 shop rerolls, gain 1 SPEED and 2 SHIELD. After lots of rerolls, you may encounter powerful Pokémon in your shop.
texts.ROCKY_HELMET: +25 DEF. Negates critical bonus damage from all incoming critical hits.
texts.ROWAP_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and cast Magic Bounce for 10 seconds
texts.RUNNING_SHOES: Gives FIELD synergy. The holder gains 5 SPEED every tile they move (jumps and dashes count for one tile).
texts.RUSTED_SWORD: It is said that a hero used this sword to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. Gives the holder +50% base ATK. Transfers to the ally with the weakest ATK when the holder faints.
texts.SACRED_ASH: Gives RESURRECTION. After resurrecting, up to 3 allies KO are resurrected as well, but without items.
texts.SAFETY_GOGGLES: Holder is immune to all negative status effects and to sandstorm damage
texts.SALAC_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 50 HP and gain 50 SPEED
texts.SCOPE_LENS: Critical attacks steal 10 PP from the target ON_HIT.
texts.SHED_SHELL: Gives BUG synergy but reduce the holder's max HP by 50% when cloned.
texts.SHELL_BELL: Holder heals for 33% of all damages inflicted
texts.SHINY_CHARM: Prevents damage and give PROTECT for 1.5 seconds and 50 PP the first time the holder gets below 30% HP
texts.SHINY_STONE: Gives LIGHT synergy. A second spotlight is projected onto the holder's tile at the start of the fight.
texts.SILK_SCARF: Combine it with other item components to make all kinds of scarves, bands and bows. Those items will be removed if you lower down NORMAL synergy level.
texts.SITRUS_BERRY: Consumed once below 50% HP, heal 100 HP and increase all healing received by 30%
texts.SMOKE_BALL: Once below 40% max HP, drop the smoke ball, gain 70 SHIELD and jump to a tile away. Every ADJACENT enemy is PARALYSIS and BLINDED for 4 seconds.
texts.SOUL_DEW: During combat, the holder gains 5 AP and 5 PP every second
texts.SPELL_TAG: Gives GHOST synergy. When the holder is KO, CURSE its attacker to be KO'd after 10 seconds
texts.STAR_DUST: After casting ability, gain 50% of max PP as SHIELD
texts.STAR_PIECE: Gives the holder one additional STAR, which increases the power of their ability.
texts.STEEL_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get STEEL type.
texts.STICKY_BARB: When struck by an attack at melee range, deal 3 + 15% of DEF as retaliation TRUE and inflict WOUND for 3 seconds to the attacker.
texts.SURFBOARD: Gives AQUATIC synergy. The holder casts Surf at every tidal wave, with the ability level matching current AQUATIC synergy level.
texts.TEAL_MASK: This carved wooden mask is adorned with crystals, grants Ogerpon the FLORA type during battle. Ogerpon loses its mask when its shield is depleted.
texts.TERRAIN_EXTENDER: At the start of the fight, holder gains either ELECTRIC_FIELD, GRASS_FIELD, PSYCHIC_FIELD or FAIRY_FIELD based on its synergies. When casting its ability, spread the field effect to all allies sharing the field's synergy.
texts.THUNDER_STONE: The holder gains the ELECTRIC type
texts.TRASH: No effect, but can be held.
texts.TWIST_BAND: Stat debuffs inflicted by enemies become buffs instead. Holder stat buffs cannot be stolen.
texts.WATER_MEMORY: Can be equipped on Silvally to get WATER type.
texts.WATER_STONE: The holder gains the WATER type
texts.WELLSPRING_MASK: This carved wooden mask is adorned with crystals, grants Ogerpon the AQUATIC type during battle. Ogerpon loses its mask when its shield is depleted.
texts.WONDER_BOX: At the beginning of each battle, WONDER_BOX is replaced by 2 temporary random craftable items (max 3 items held)
texts.XRAY_VISION: Holder is immune to SLEEP and their attacks can no longer miss.
